{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ungoth Valley''' was a location on [[Kro Var]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and marked by prominent [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flows. [[Shapers of Kro Var]] from that area exhibited particular aptitude for the fire element and its associated [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]].
